answer: Each epoch, five random peers panel-audit one identity's work; a majority flagging a fake slashes its 50-credit bond and pays the panel. A gale of fakes cannot share one good record: the k-th fake posts its own 50 credits and faces its own draw, so 1,000 fakes risk 50,000 credits, detection odds rising per panel. A copied relic of another's work fails the freshness check against its author's history. No ivory-tower exemption: seniors draw equally. Honest agents post one bond, reclaimed after a clean epoch.
